obligation.exact_statement: On the exact smoothed reference and the explicitly compiled theta-independent family of the Route A actual-circuit prerequisite, prove for each fixed D1 theta that max_s TV(Pi_N(H;s),p_theta(.|s))->0 almost surely, hence actual terminal-query TV converges almost surely and in expectation despite query/history dependence. State any claim for conditional terminal-query risk separately and justify it. Determine the population limit of the specified direct matched outcome readout q_s, give necessary and sufficient equality-to-target conditions for a fixed context and all contexts, and exhibit a stationary strictly positive stochastic second-order counterexample to unqualified direct-readout consistency. Keep this theorem conditional on an admitted or self-contained actual implementation result; statistical formulas alone do not discharge the implementation prerequisite.

assumptions: D1-D8 are the frozen first-stage definitions; theta is unknown at prediction time.
Stationary initialization and strictly positive symbol-successor probabilities hold per fixed theta, without a common lower bound across the rare family.
All network-visible side information and resources are charged. Primary guarantees are forward guarantees, not unproved learnability claims.
Full-context and itemwise kernels, rare and uniform process families, and distinct error models remain separately scoped.
